<var>
$DPS$ = $DPSGUN$ + $DPSPOISON$
$DPSGUN$ = (Damage * Burst Count) / (Cooldown + (Firerate * Burst Count))
$DPSPOISON$ = (Poison Damage / Tick)
$DPS2$ = $DPS2GUN$ + $DPS2POISON$
$DPS2GUN$ = Damage / Firerate
$DPS2POISON$ = Poison Damage / Tick
$CE$ = Total Cost / DPS
$TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$
$TED$ = Poison Damage * (Poison Time / Tick)
$COST$ = 525; 200; 800; 3500; 14000
$FSE-DETECTION$ = ; 0; 3
$FSE-UPGRADE$ = Faster Reloading; Poisonous Bullets; Sinister Gear; Going Nuclear!
$FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = File:ToxicGunnerLevel1Icon.png; File:ToxicGunnerLevel2Icon.png; File:ToxicGunnerLevel3Icon.png; File:ToxicGunnerLevel4Icon.png
$FSE-META$ = Exclusive; File:ToxicGunnerNewIcon.png
$CREF$ = <ref>Firerate only applies to the burst and is not the time between bursts.</ref>
$TREF$ = <ref>Total Elapsed Damage is calculated as Poison Damage × (Poison Time ÷ Tick)</ref>
$DREF$ = <ref>DPS is calculated as (Damage × Burst Count) ÷ (Cooldown + (Firerate × Burst Count)) + (Poison Damage ÷ Tick).<br/>When the '''Toxic Gunner''' stops firing in bursts, it is calculated as Damage ÷ Firerate + Poison Damage ÷ Tick<br/>DPS assumes all shots poison the same enemy.</ref>
$R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
</var>
